prompt:
Edit image 1, the THREE-POSE RIGHT / REAR HAND upper-body hook strip. Images 2 and 3 are STRICT STYLE AND COSTUME REFERENCES: image 2 is the approved LEFT hook strip, image 3 is the original fighting idle. You must paint image 1 to look like it was drawn by the same person at the same time as image 2, while preserving image 1's exact three RIGHT hook poses, limb geometry, arm assignment, sprite placement, cropping, camera and three cell layout. Do NOT copy the left hook poses. All face screen RIGHT. Keep aspect ratio and three equal cells, full transparent background.
The current image 1 is REJECTED for style drift: thick clean cartoon contours, coarse black dots/stippling and short random dashes on skin and cloth, bright pink skin, excessively ragged sleeve edges, inflated muscles. Fix those defects specifically. Match the APPROVED image 2: finer uneven black ink outlines, long fine diagonal hatching and selective cross hatching, detailed hand-drawn muscle shading, muted copper/peach light with dark brown shadows, dusty dark burgundy t-shirt. Distinct dense line textures, not a stippled grain/noise filter. Same directional warm light from image 3, warmer bright edge on upper-left shoulder and arm, dark near torso. Match line density, line weight, fabric color and skin shade to image 2. Shirt has the SAME simple short sleeve cut as image 2 and image 3; irregular worn edge is modest, not torn into spikes. Same ordinary thin creased crewneck, no hood, no scarf, no raised or draped collar; small seam lies at base of bare neck. Maintain garment continuity in all three cells. Avoid broad smooth parallel fabric ribbons: keep sharp angular creases and irregular diagonal hatch shadows as approved reference. Keep exact skin limb shape and fist poses; do not lengthen, thicken or add muscles or arms. Preserve forearm/fist silhouettes and shoulder positions. No embellishments. No new design. Keep the same angry angular narrow head and short upright spiked hair.
Output only the repaired three-pose upper-body animation strip, on a truly transparent background, without text, checkerboard, panels or labels. This is STYLE REPAIR of image 1, not new concepts.
